excerpts.text: Image digests Images using the v2 or later image format have a content-addressable identifier called a digest. As long as the input used to generate the image is unchanged, the digest value is predictable. The following example runs a container from the alpine image with the sha256:9cacb71397b640eca97488cf08582ae4e4068513101088e9f96c9814bfda95e0 digest: $ docker run alpine@sha256:9cacb71397b640eca97488cf08582ae4e4068513101088e9f96c9814bfda95e0 date
